name: GST & Billing Sync by TDLStore.in
author: Atharv IT Solutions

sections.description:
Generate GST-compliant tax invoices for your WooCommerce store and securely sync invoice data with TallyPrime accounting software through API—seamlessly and effortlessly.

Automate your invoicing workflow with features such as customizable invoice numbering, GSTIN collection at checkout, professional tax invoice printing, Sales Register export, and much more.

GST & Billing Sync by TDLStore.in is a free WordPress plugin designed to simplify GST invoicing and accounting for WooCommerce store owners. Automatically generate and issue GST-compliant tax invoices to customers, manage invoice numbering, capture customer GSTIN details, and retrieve WooCommerce invoice and order data for seamless synchronization with TallyPrime.

Whether you’re managing GST billing or streamlining your accounting workflow, GST & Billing Sync helps you reduce manual work, minimize errors, and keep your WooCommerce sales data organized.

Key Features

WooCommerce Orders Sync with TallyPrime: Seamlessly synchronize WooCommerce orders with TallyPrime using a secure, token-protected REST API. Supports automatic creation of Customer Masters and Item Masters, duplicate invoice prevention, and both scheduled automatic synchronization and manual synchronization from TallyPrime. A compatible Paid TDL add-on for TallyPrime is required.

Flexible Invoice Numbering: Automatically assign unique Tax Invoice numbers to WooCommerce orders. Configure invoice prefixes and suffixes, sequence length, zero-padding, starting number, invoice assignment trigger, and financial-year-based sequence reset rules.

GSTIN Field at Checkout: Collect customer GSTIN during checkout. Configure the field as optional or mandatory, validate GSTIN format before submission, and save the GSTIN to the customer’s profile for convenient reuse on future orders.

Customer GSTIN Management: Store customer GSTIN details with customer and order information, subject to the supported checkout flow, helping maintain GST-related customer records.

GST Tax Invoice Printing: Generate and print invoices containing order details, invoice number, product SKU, HSN codes, GST details, and payment information.

Product HSN Code Management: Add HSN codes to WooCommerce products and include them in invoice printing and TallyPrime synchronization data.

Sales Register Export: Export date-range-based Sales Register data with GST details for accounting, reconciliation, and reporting purposes.

Free plugin: This WordPress plugin is developed & provided free of charge by TDLStore.in.

REST API

The plugin provides an endpoint at:

/wp-json/tdlsync/v1/orders

Enable the endpoint and configure its access token in WooCommerce > GST & Billing Sync. Requests must include the configured token and supported order filters/pagination parameters. Keep the token private; anyone who obtains it may be able to retrieve the order fields exposed by the endpoint.

Use HTTPS on your website. Do not publish the access token in public pages, source code repositories, support forums or screenshots.

Privacy

When the TallyPrime sync API is enabled and called by an authorised client, the plugin returns WooCommerce order information required for billing and synchronisation. This may include customer names, billing and shipping addresses, contact information, GSTIN, product/order details, payment method and transaction reference, depending on the order and fields requested.

The plugin does not send order data to TDLStore.in as part of the local order retrieval operation. The store owner is responsible for protecting the sync access token, securing the website with HTTPS, configuring access appropriately and informing customers about the store’s data practices.

The plugin stores invoice numbering settings, the sync access token, invoice number/order metadata, GSTIN information and product HSN metadata in the site’s WordPress/WooCommerce database.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gst-billing-sync-by-tdlstore-in directory, or install the ZIP through Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and active.
  4. Open WooCommerce > GST & Billing Sync.
  5. Configure invoice numbering and GSTIN options as required.
  6. Enable the TallyPrime order sync API only if you intend to use it, and keep its access token secure.
  7. Add HSN codes to products under Product data > Inventory if you want them displayed on printed invoices.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin free?

Yes. The WordPress plugin is free to use.

Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Does it automatically create vouchers inside TallyPrime?

No. The plugin exposes WooCommerce order data through a token-protected REST API. You will need to load our TDL add-on in your TallyPrime and define secured API token to sync data with TallyPrime.

Do I need WooCommerce REST API consumer keys?

No. The plugin reads orders internally from WooCommerce and protects its dedicated sync endpoint using the Tally Sync Access Token configured in the plugin settings.

How do I protect the sync endpoint?

Use HTTPS, keep the access token confidential, grant it only to trusted TallyPrime installations, and regenerate it if you believe it has been exposed.

Where do I enter a product HSN code?

Edit a product, open Product data > Inventory, and enter the HSN Code field.

Where can I find support?

Email support@tdlstore.in or visit https://tdlstore.in/.
